name: EPIC 204922278
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 2, 7.6 solar radii and 1.25 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 204922278 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM radius (solar radii) 7.574209 (16th-84th percentiles 7.326366-7.834668), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 204922278 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.25272 (16th-84th percentiles 1.159223-1.359567), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 204922278: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4563.7456 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 204922278 (K2 campaign 2): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1792.460938 (16th-84th percentiles 1744.277344-1842.851562), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 1.13 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,793 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 2, give 1.25 solar masses and 7.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,564 K at its surface.
